reason: Receipts are my bookkeeper's job, not mine. I'm not going to add some new bot to my site groups myself in a busy week. I'd forward it to her, and she'll probably stick with how she already does it.
objection: Will this little bot still exist in a year? If it shuts down halfway through the tax year, I'm stuck rebuilding everything right when my accountant needs it. And half my receipts go missing because the guys never send them in the first place. A bot doesn't fix that.
would_change_my_mind: My bookkeeper telling me she already uses it with her other clients and wants me on it, or another contractor I know who has run it for six months or more.
